messages:
Aisha (partnerships): Quick kickoff — we need to get AWS/GCP/Azure listings prepped for the new Dedicated offering. Owners + blockers? Can we confirm publisher access, legal artifacts, and SKU decisions by EOW?
Tom (cloud-ops): I can own publisher account enrollment for AWS and GCP. Need an org admin email and a billing contact. For Azure Marketplace we need the commercial marketplace publisher ID — who has that?
Priya (product): Packaging question: do we want a single multi-tier SKU (starter/pro/enterprise) or separate listings per tier? My recommendation: single listing with tier metadata so trials flow to in-product upsell.
Liam (legal): Heads up — EULA + DPA templates need to be localized for EU/UK. Also export classification check required for the binary/AMI references. I can prep EU/UK EULA drafts but need proposed trial terms.
Sam (partner-eng): For the AMI/VM images we need the CI artifact paths and a signed manifest. I'll set up a private S3 bucket and a short-lived presigned URL flow for marketplace ingestion. Example manifest snippet: 
```
name: redwood-inference-dedicated
version: 2026.03.01
artifacts:
  - type: ami
    id: ami-0abcd1234ef
    region: us-west-2
```

Tom (cloud-ops): +1. Also need an STS role we can hand to the publisher account for automated ingestion. Sam, can you add the role ARN to the manifest?
Sam (partner-eng): Yep, will add role ARN and upload to s3://redwood-marketplace-manifests/3812345678/manifest.yaml. I'll send the presigned link in this thread when done.
Aisha (partnerships): @Tom can you confirm who will be the billing contact? @Liam we need the DPA + EULA by Thu for legal review with partner ops.
Tom (cloud-ops): Billing contact = finance+marketplace@redwood.ai (cc'ing finance).
Liam (legal): Noted — DPA draft in progress. Will share redlines in Docs by Thu morning.
Priya (product): On SKU model: leaning single listing with feature flags per tier. Ops: can the marketplace metadata include a trial SKU that maps to in-product seat unlocking?
Sam (partner-eng): Yes — we'll surface a trial token parameter in the ingestion metadata so the onboarding flow can consume it. Need the parameter name and TTL.
Priya (product): Use parameter: marketplace_trial_token, TTL 30d.
jen-bot: Created checklist card: Marketplace Onboard 3812345678 — assignees: Tom, Sam, Liam, Priya — due: 2026-03-27. URL: https://redwood.internal/board/marketplace/3812345678
Aisha (partnerships): OK next steps:
- Tom: start publisher enrollment + provide publisher ID (due Tue)
- Sam: upload manifest + role ARN + presigned link (due Wed)
- Liam: share localized DPA + EULA drafts (due Thu)
- Priya: finalize SKU mapping and trial param (due Wed)
I'll follow up with a short launch checklist doc after we have the artifacts. Thanks team :rocket:
Tom (cloud-ops): On it.
Sam (partner-eng): uploading manifest now — will post link when ready.
Liam (legal): will ping if we need clarifications on trial language.
Priya (product): adding marketplace metadata to the productworkboard.
Aisha (partnerships): If anyone hits a blocker ping here and tag @aisha. For Azure publisher ID, @sam — can you check if our partner account still has the publisher mapping?
Sam (partner-eng): checking Azure portal now — will report back.
